title: tools: dmx manuf ids: update script for table errors
description:
A couple of rows in the table lack the 'h' in the hex column or
have an extra space, which was causing the script to fail. Allow
that. Also note that the header row doesn't match the regex anymore,
due to a background color being added.

Also update the script to allow being run from other locations than
the root dir.

Run the script and update.

See !25073 for a recent failure.

AI-Assisted: no
